name: cogumi-eval
description: Evaluate any Claude plugin or skill. Reads its code to derive rubrics, runs it with a dynamic user proxy, judges against a baseline, and publishes a comparison report.

commands.name: eval
commands.description: Full eval: read code → derive rubrics → confirm design → generate all arms → judge → publish report.

commands.name: ab
commands.description: Quick A/B: baseline vs one named plugin or skill. Auto-detects type, skips arm-selection step, runs all phases.

commands.name: ab-plugin
commands.description: Run the plugin arm in isolation: execute the named plugin end-to-end and return its raw output, labelled. No comparison.

commands.name: ab-skill
commands.description: Run the skill arm in isolation: execute the named skill end-to-end and return its raw output, labelled. No comparison.
